articles.title: There are five signs that someone dislikes you – but it’s best to ignore them | Polly Hudson
articles.summary: All the possible indications, from eye contact to body language, come with a disclaimer. The truth is, you can never be totally sure... I’d be far less paranoid if everyone wasn’t out to get me, so when BBC Science Focus dangled “ The subtle signs somebody secretly dislikes you ”, I’ve never…
body: The first indication? They avoid eye contact. Apparently “someone who repeatedly looks away, scans the room or avoids mutual gaze might be creating psychological distance”. Agreed. But they may also be checking to see who else arrives, which might not mean they secretly hate you, only that they secretly don’t like you as much as whoever just came in.

The second sign is unarguably more convincing. “Their facial expressions show contempt or disgust.” Admittedly, I’m no psychologist, but still, if someone looked contemptuous or disgusted while interacting with me, I’d be pretty confident in concluding that they aren’t my greatest fan all on my own. File this one under bear/woods, pope/Catholic.

Third up, they “smile less around you”. This feels dangerous, because the only way to know whether they are smiling less around you than other humans they come into contact with is to put them under surveillance and keep a tally. If they didn’t dislike you before you hid in a bush counting their grins, they probably would afterwards.

articles.title: The kindness of strangers: After my wife died, a football club made an extraordinary gesture
articles.summary: My son had only played two seasons for St Mary’s Greensborough, five years earlier. I don’t know how they even got our new address but they took the time to send him a care package. Footy clubs, and the AFL specifically, have a lot to answer for in terms of sexism.
body: When we lived in Melbourne many years ago, my son played a couple of seasons for St Mary’s Greensborough. Unfortunately for him, I secured a job in central Queensland and moved the family north.

During our new adventure, my wife was diagnosed with breast cancer. It was stage four, so she was in trouble straight away. She battled it fiercely but died in 2015, about five years after we left Melbourne.

As my children and I began to emerge from the fog of grief, a package arrived in the mail for my son. Inside was a St Mary’s Greensborough football jersey with our surname emblazoned across the back. Attached was a note that read: “Thinking of you after the loss of your mum.”
The support around us as a family when my wife was sick, and when she died, was fantastic. I am so grateful for that. But sometimes it’s the gestures that come out of left field that really move you.
points: My son had only played two seasons for St Mary’s Greensborough, five years earlier.
I don’t know how they even got our new address but they took the time to send him a care package.
Footy clubs, and the AFL specifically, have a lot to answer for in terms of sexism.

articles.title: Forget the seven-year itch: opposite-sex marriages more likely to end after two decades
articles.summary: ONS data for England and Wales shows 26% of heterosexual divorces in 2025 followed 20 years or more of marriage. Most couples are aware of the dreaded “seven-year itch”, when the honeymoon period wears off and real life starts to bite.
body: Now official data has shown that couples in England and Wales are more likely to split after 20 years. According to Office for National Statistics figures, more than a quarter of all divorces between opposite-sex couples happened after 20 years or longer of marriage.

The former Strictly presenter Tess Daly recently separated from her husband, the presenter Vernon Kay, after 22 years of marriage. The Downton Abbey actor Hugh Bonneville split from his wife, Lulu Williams, in 2023 after 25 years, and in 2019, Colin Firth announced his separation from wife, Livia Giuggioli, after 22. Last year, the Hollywood actor Nicole Kidman and singer Keith Urban separated after almost 20 years of marriage.

Divorce lawyers have previously said some couples are putting off splitting up because of the cost of living crisis. Recent figures have shown the average length of a marriage ending in divorce in England and Wales reached a record high last year.

ONS figures have long appeared to show that the seven-year itch exists; since records began in 1963, the largest proportion of divorces each year has almost always been among those who have spent between five and nine years as a couple.
points: ONS data for England and Wales shows 26% of heterosexual divorces in 2025 followed 20 years or more of marriage.

articles.title: The Most Evocative Period Dramas of the 21st Century
articles.summary: The best period dramas whisk viewers to times and places that feel a world away from modern life. Here are our favorites, from “Gosford Park” to “The Crown.”
body: Sumptuous costume dramas can provide a much-needed escape in troubling times, but if you’re tired of the usual assortment of airless parlors, manicured lawns, and straight-laced suitors, there is an alternative: a subset of recent films and series that play with our expectations of the genre. Combining post-punk soundtracks with cross-dressing, lobster racing, color-blind casting, and illicit love affairs, they allow us to view history through a new lens and feel surprisingly modern as a result. See our favorites below.

You can rely on Armando Iannucci to breathe new life into Charles Dickens’s sprawling bildungsroman. In the hands of the endlessly inventive comedian, the tale of a boy who pulls himself up by his bootstraps and seeks out fame and fortune becomes a madcap delight complete with a zingy script, cartoonish punch-ups, collapsing sets, and a heady dose of magical realism. Dev Patel is the dashing lead, supported by Peter Capaldi as a top-hatted menace and Tilda Swinton as an eccentric landowner who kicks trespassers off their donkeys.
points: The best period dramas whisk viewers to times and places that feel a world away from modern life.

articles.title: Kylie Jenner Debuts on the Victoria’s Secret Runway in its $50 Million Fantasy Bra
articles.summary: The reality TV star and entrepreneur stepped onto the Victoria's Secret catwalk wearing the most expensive Fantasy Bra to date.
body: For the return of Victoria’s Secret’s pricey and gemstone-encrusted Fantasy Bra—the first time the brand has put it on its runway since 2018—team VS needed a model who is not merely of the moment, but transcends it. They got just that with Kylie Jenner, the reality TV star-turned-beauty entrepreneur, who, with 380 million followers on Instagram, is one of the most popular personalities on the platform. Jenner, 29, stepped out onto the catwalk wearing a gauzy mini skirt, clear heels, and white feathered wings—but it was ultimately the Fantasy Bra that was the center of attention.

To mark its grand return, the brand pulled out all the stops with the bra itself, revealing a design that features 4,410 natural diamonds surrounding a 75.54-carat radiant-cut Fancy Vivid yellow diamond. It took 15 craftspeople more than 1,000 hours to build it, and the finished product weighs just under four pounds. The total cost? A whopping $50 million, the highest price (by some $35 million) for a Fantasy Bra to date.
points: The reality TV star and entrepreneur stepped onto the Victoria's Secret catwalk wearing the most expensive Fantasy Bra to date.

articles.title: Trinity Rodman Went From the Soccer Field to the Runway at the 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show
articles.summary: The Washington Spirit forward traded the pitch for the catwalk at Sunday’s show.
body: The Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show is a reliable hotbed of A-list talent, from the fashion world and beyond—and this year’s event was no exception. Among the likes of models Alex Consani, Paloma Elsesser, Adriana Lima, Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, and new mom Barbara Palvin on the runway Sunday was one familiar face from a very different field: soccer star Trinity Rodman.

During the Pink section of the long-running fashion show—soundtracked by a rousing Katseye medley—Rodman, a forward for the Washington Spirit, strutted down the catwalk in a cropped black tank and boyshorts, accessorized with a silvery Pink pup and slingbacks. Her surprise appearance (coming just a day after her squad bested Gotham FC at home, 1-0) follows thrilling runway turns from fellow athletes Angel Reese and Suni Lee on last year’s runway.
points: The Washington Spirit forward traded the pitch for the catwalk at Sunday’s show.
